title: How the book works (leverage explainer)
hypothesis: The book's Sharpe is invariant to the vol target; CAGR is a leverage dial.
question: How do return and drawdown scale when the book is levered to different volatility targets?
prior: For a constant leverage multiplier, Sharpe is unchanged by construction (before financing costs).
method: Same book re-levered to 3%–20% annualised vol.
verdict_reason: Sharpe stayed at 1.04 at every target; CAGR and drawdown scaled together. We chose 8% vol for deployment as a risk-appetite choice, not an alpha signal.
lessons: Report Sharpe and drawdown, not CAGR, when comparing strategies at different leverage.
footer: Research code is private; methods summarised below.
